loops-desc: Shaqooyinka parser-ka ee lagu fuliyo wareegyo
loops_max: Tirada ugu badan ee wareegyada ayaa la fuliyay
loops-config-countlimit: Isbeddelka habaynta ee qeexaya tirada ugu badan ee wareegyada la oggol yahay ('-1' => xad ma jiro). '#forargs' iyo '#fornumargs' lama xaddido.
loops-config-enabledfunctions: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in la qeexo shaqooyinka ay bixiso 'Loops' ee laga hawlgelinayo wiki-ga. Haddii kordhinta 'Variables' aan la rakibin, '#loop', '#forargs' iyo '#fornumargs' si toos ah ayaa loo damin doonaa.
